STEP 6. Check the harness wire between key reminder 
switch connector C-88 and ETACS-ECU connector C-111.
Q: Is the harness wire between key reminder switch 
connector C-88 and ETACS-ECU connector C-111 in 
good condition?
YES : Replace the ETACS-ECU. The key reminder switch 
input signal should be able to be checked and the 
functions, which are described in the "Technical 
Description (comment)," should work normally.
NO : Repair it. The key reminder switch input signal should 
be able to be checked and the functions, which are 
described in the "Technical Description (comment)," 
should work normally.
